Subject: POC orientation & hands-on session — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Elena —

Great to be moving forward on the Finlytics pilot. To get the POC into a hands-on state we typically run a short kickoff call (30–45m) to introduce stakeholders and align on goals, then follow with a 2–3 hour working session focused on prompt review, routing decisions, and a short load rehearsal (~10k tokens/min target).

Proposed kickoff windows (PDT):
- Thu 24 Mar, 10:00–10:45 (preferred for our APAC-safe overlap)
- Thu 24 Mar, 14:00–14:45 (alternate)

If you can confirm which works and who from your side will attend (roles + escalation contact), we’ll send calendar invites and a short runbook. We’d like:
- Product/PO (success criteria)
- Engineering or ML lead (for prompt & routing specifics)
- A technical contact who can approve short load tests on your side (IP/ingress confirmation)

I’m attaching a one-page POC checklist and a proposed load-test plan.

Agenda (kickoff):
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Goals & success criteria (10m)
- Logistics for working session (10m)

Agenda (hands-on):
- Prompt review & test cases (45m)
- Routing & model variant discussion (30m)
- Load rehearsal + quick post-check (45m)

Thanks — happy to adjust windows.

— Iren
